purpose: Show a transformation. Split screen, old vs new, verdict at the end.
use_when: Old vs new, dirty vs clean, broken vs fixed, manual vs machine
avoid_when: Explaining a mechanism is the point
Footage is a single continuous process
best_for_niches: one home trade at a time

canvas.note: Labels BEFORE / AFTER must stay on screen during their beat.

beats.note: Left side only, label BEFORE, desaturated.
Right side / full screen, label AFTER, vivid.
One line: what changed and why it matters.

allowed_effects_only.note: Agent may ONLY choose values from these lists. Never invent a new effect, transition, filter or text_anim name.

rules_for_agent: Pick template_id from templates/index.json only. Never invent a template_id.
Merge content layer (segments/voiceover/text_overlay/sfx_cue from Stage 1-2) with this style layer. Do not rewrite voiceover to fit the template.
Per-video override: change style fields inside that video's JSON only. Do NOT edit the template file.
Permanent change: edit the template file, bump version (1.1.0 -> 1.2.0), keep old videos unchanged, test-render 1 clip before using it for a batch.
Validate JSON against the schema before every fablecut_patch_project call. Invalid JSON: stop and report, do not patch.
Keep time_range contiguous: next start == previous end, no gaps, total 30-60s for a Short.
Text overlay: max 4 words per beat, UPPER CASE for hook text, keep text inside 9:16 safe area (top 10% and bottom 15% reserved for UI).
Use fablecut_patch_project for edits, not a full project.json rewrite when only part changes.
